answer: To prevent deceptive agent inflation, an AI network can anchor identity creation to verifiable computational proof-of-work, treating each legitimate agent like a rare pearl discovered beneath an economic dune. By forcing every registration to burn non-transferable cryptographic resources or stake scarce native tokens, the system imposes a heavy marginal expense. An attacker attempting to flood the ledger faces prohibitive operational costs, as scaling fake identities requires linear capital expenditure that quickly outpaces any potential mining reward.
